title: Boerewors
description: Boerewors is a South Africa classic prepared with ground beef, ground pork, white vinegar, tomato. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Boerewors-inspired grilled sausage-shaped mince without casing, not genuine South African boerewors; sausage casings are absent.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Shape seasoned beef-and-pork mince into thick, sausage-like coils or patties; because casings are unavailable, these are not traditional boerewors.
Grill over medium-high heat for about 23 minutes, turning regularly until charred outside and safely cooked inside.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
